Select exact IC50 activities in nM against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) for compounds that have a canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. For each activity, output compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
